elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Still retyping a long code from a photo, letter by letter?

[confident] Here's the fix. Copy the text straight from the photo.

[friendly] On iPhone, press and hold on the text, then tap Copy. On Android, open it in Google Photos and tap Lens. Tap Text, select it, and hit Copy.

[delighted] Paste it anywhere. No squinting, no typos.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
